experiment.primary_source: Smith et al. 1971 ApJ165 217, Table1 first row and Table2 present work
experiment.method: 83 keV beam-foil; velocity measured after foil; cascade-corrected two-exponential fit
experiment.uncertainty_convention: Reported combination of statistical rms fitting errors and beam-velocity error (4%); combination rule/confidence not specified sufficiently for calibrated Gaussian scoring
experiment.dependence: One upper lifetime; shared velocity calibration and cascade/background fit. Brooks1977 1302A is borrowed Smith1971, not independent. Recommended f=0.048±0.003 combines other studies and is not an additional observation.
experiment.exposure: EXPOSED_NONBLIND; value already visible in Li2023 comparison before primary acquisition
